candidates.description: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team What you’ll do We’re looking for an experienced writer to develop data-backed theses and original content pieces about how startups and AI-native businesses launch, monetize, and grow. In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with contributors across the product marketing, product, engineering, and demand generation teams to produce compelling content that engages and informs our audience. This is a unique opportunity for a collaborative writer and content producer who excels at translating complex concepts in AI, billing infrastructure, and revenue growth into accessible insights. candidates.description: The Company At Springboard, we’re on a mission to bridge the world’s skills gap, offering transformative online education in data science, UI/UX design, machine learning, and coding. Our courses may be tech-enabled, but we’re ultimately human-centric: each student taps into a vast community throughout their time with us, engaging with fellow students, industry-expert mentors, student advisors, and career coaches, the goal of which is to successfully transition students into their dream job. Through this hybrid approach, we’ve helped thousands of learners revamp their careers and, by extension, their lives, with hundreds of top-notch job offers received every year and a near-perfect placement rate for our program graduates. Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Data Analytics professional with content and curriculum design experience to serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for our Data Analytics Bootcamp. This SME will partner with Springboard’s learning team to review and update our curriculum and develop net-new learning content to ensure our program reflects current industry expectations for entry-level data analytics roles.
